retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, split-face portrait using bold primary colors and hand-drawn scribbles to create a raw, 1980s neo-expressionist aesthetic.
excludeWhen: clean minimalist vector art is required
soft pastel color palettes are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical composition featuring a dual-toned face split vertically between black and yellow, overlaid with raw, gestural line work and blocky, hand-lettered text boxes.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical bisecting line dividing the central face into high-contrast color zones
Hand-drawn scribbles and patterns filling the background and hair areas
Rectangular text blocks overlapping the forehead area
Vertical text running along the left margin
coreInvariants: High-contrast yellow and black color split
Asymmetrical composition with heavy left-side vertical text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large, stylized face occupies the center and right two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The sharp vertical divide between the black and yellow halves of the face.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the large vertical text on the left, across the central face, to the horizontal text blocks on the forehead.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with textures, patterns, and text.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red (small square accents) and Teal (background strip)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the deep black and bright yellow; muted saturation in the grey background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the main title have exaggerated, sharp terminals
Vertical text is elongated and loosely spaced
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between large vertical script and blocky horizontal sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Torn-edge paper effect for text boxes

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the raw, expressive energy of the illustration

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a split-face illustration with the left side in solid black and the right side in bright yellow. Add a grey background with a teal vertical strip on the far left. Include scribbled line art for hair and facial features.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add hand-drawn, marker-style text. Place one large vertical string on the left grey area. Place two horizontal text strings inside grey rectangular boxes on the forehead area.

verificationChecks: Is the face split vertically between black and yellow?
Is the text hand-drawn and irregular?
Are there scribbled textures in the hair area?
Is there a vertical text element on the left side?

mustRedesign: Avoid using standard digital fonts; must look hand-drawn
Ensure the split between colors is sharp and vertical
postGenerationChecks: Verify hand-drawn quality of all lines
Ensure text is integrated into the collage style
recipe.reuseFormula: 80s Neo-Expressionism + Split-Face Portrait + Hand-Drawn Typography + High Contrast Palette
